name: jev-stop
description: Codex Stop guard that asks Jev whether a final response leaves authorized work unfinished.
notes: Python standard-library implementation invoked with uv on macOS or Linux.
Requires a TypeSafe JEV_API_KEY and sends redacted dialogue to its API.
Stop allows at most one continuation; missing context and API failures allow the stop.
The question file stays beside the hook under .codex/hooks.
